description: The existing 1970 actualist Th3 conditional is preserved. Its stated smaller axiom bundle has a model with a world, but ACTUALIST-POSSIBILITY-BOUNDARY now proves its possibility antecedent false already from retained Ax3 and symmetry. Thus premise satisfiability is not a nonvacuity certificate for this route to necessary existence. This is a new formal consequence of the encoded definitions, not an attribution of that observation to the AFP authors or a refutation of Scott or ordinary theism.
